data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Wini was a name given to the jesters and entertainers who brought joy and delight to people. This name has a rich spiritual significance as it represents the joy and happiness that comes from serving others and spreading positivity. The name Wini carries the meaning “Jester, delight” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wini usually hope their child will grow to embody jester, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
